subject: Possible to centre x-axis ticks in geom_histogram

messages.author: b2e4f05ddb93f8fd
messages.subject: Possible to centre x-axis ticks in geom_histogram
parts:
Hi,

just wondering if it is possible to move the x-axis ticks when using
geom_histogram so that they are in the middle of the bars, rather than
the right hand edge of the bar.

can't find any mention on google....

here's my simple 2line plot

> m<-ggplot(data,aes(x=rest_delta))
> m + geom_histogram(aes(fill=..count..),binwidth=1)

thanks,
Scott
